title: Pixel ring

techniques.name: Dot-screen bloom

spin.label: Turn
spin.note: Turns the helix about its axis.

focus.label: In focus
focus.note: How many of the newest exchanges are lit as in focus: the page holds 4 to 7.

lobe.label: Lobe reach
lobe.note: How long each message’s lobe of dots is drawn along its reach, against the page’s own.

pitch.label: Screen pitch
pitch.note: Spacing of the halftone screen the lobes are printed through, against the filed figure’s own: smaller packs a finer screen, larger opens bold dots.

weight.label: Line weight
weight.note: Weight of the two fine lines that wind through the newest lobes, with their halo.

techniques.implementation: A scatter of marks is printed through a coarse dot screen; dot size carries the density, so the bloom fades at its edge without a gradient. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its camera, steps, focus and bars given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
